description: One Robinhood Chain token (0x + 40 hex) as it trades now: market cap, liquidity, volume, 24h buys and sells with distinct buyer and seller wallets, whether it is an official Robinhood stock token, the developer's launch record and the wallet that first funded the developer, with that funder's record. Wallets come as prefixes. For flags and sellability use rh_token_safety; for trades use rh_swaps.
name: rh_token_snapshot
title: Robinhood Chain token snapshot
